coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Service enterprises need a licence, charter capital of VND 5 billion and a deposit (Arts. 7(5), 10, 24); they compensate only damage they cause (Art. 26(2)(h)); the Law sets no joint liability with the employer. Law 22/2026 (from 1 March 2027) moves licence procedures to a decree.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service fees are capped at one month's salary per 12 months, three months at most (Art. 23(4)(a)), and may be collected only after the supply contract is approved and the placement contract signed (Art. 23(2)(c)); brokerage may not be charged to workers (Art. 7(8)). Circular 09/2026 sets zero brokerage for Japan and zero service fees for some Japanese programs.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Arts. 7(8), 23; Circular 09/2026 · official text: https://vbpl.vn/

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: The supply contract has statutory minimum contents and needs prior Ministry approval (Arts. 19(2), 20(1)); the worker signs a written placement contract in the model form (Art. 21).

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Orientation with a completion certificate is compulsory (Arts. 6(2)(c), 44(5), 65(2)) and covers rights and hotlines (Art. 65(1)); 74 periods under Circular 21/2021. The Law does not say who pays.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Arts. 6, 44, 65; Circular 21/2021 Art. 12 · official text: https://vbpl.vn/

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: The Overseas Employment Support Fund (Arts. 66–68) supports early return, abuse, disputes and death; under Decision 34/2025/QĐ-TTg (replacing Decision 40/2021, from 15 September 2025) it pays half of lawyer and court costs up to VND 50 million, VND 40 million on death and half the cost of repatriating remains. Social insurance also applies.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Arts. 6, 66–68; Decision 34/2025/QĐ-TTg · official text: https://vbpl.vn/

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
coded.vl: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
coded.n: The Ministry, with Foreign Affairs, posts officials to missions to manage workers abroad (Art. 70(2)(c)), and missions have statutory duties toward workers (Art. 71).

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: Complaints go to the authority, which can sanction enterprises and order refunds with interest and compensation for damage caused (Decree 283/2026 Art. 49, replacing Decree 12/2022 from 10 September 2026); this is a remedial order, not an adjudicating body, and other claims go to the courts.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Arts. 6, 25, 69, 72; Decree 283/2026 Art. 49 · official text: https://vbpl.vn/

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: Minimum age 18 (Art. 3(1)); prohibited jobs and areas (Art. 7(12)–(13)) are sex-neutral on their face.

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: The Ministry guides provinces, which may adopt support 'based on budget capacity'; employment service centers give labor-market information and enterprises help with job referral (Art. 60); psychosocial counseling is only encouraged (Art. 61). No public body has a duty to provide reintegration services. Recoded from 2 to 1 on 13 November 2026.

coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Service enterprises need a licence, legal capital and a deposit; they answer for their own obligations and must settle the worker's rights if the employer defaults in some cases, but no general joint liability with the employer is written in the Law.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service fees are capped (in general one month's salary per 12 months, at most three months' salary) and must be agreed after the supply contract is signed; the 2020 Law removed the worker's duty to refund brokerage commissions; the fee cap is zero for Japan under the 2024 amendment.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Art. 23; Circular 21/2021 as amended by Circular 02/2024 and Circular 09/2026

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: A written contract with statutory minimum content is required, and the supply contract must be registered with or approved by the authority before workers are recruited.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Orientation education with a completion certificate is compulsory before departure; the cost may be collected from the worker.

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: Workers and enterprises contribute to the Overseas Employment Support Fund, which supports workers who die, are injured or must return early and funds legal support; social insurance also applies.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
coded.vl: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
coded.n: The Law provides for labor management sections in missions in countries receiving Vietnamese workers.

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: Complaints go to the authority, which can sanction enterprises and order refunds; compensation claims go to the courts.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: Minimum age 18; the Law lists prohibited jobs and areas (for example some jobs in nightlife and in conflict zones), sex-neutral on their face.
coded.src: Law 69/2020 Art. 7, Appendix (prohibited jobs and areas)

coded.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
coded.vl: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
coded.n: The state supports returning workers with job counseling, referral and self-employment loans through employment service centers.

coded.fn: Departure without sex, age or destination bans
coded.vl: No ban or restriction specific to domestic workers
coded.n: No ban specific to domestic workers.

coded.vl: Contract verified or approved by a state body
coded.n: Contract registered with the labor authority.

coded.fn: No recruitment fees for domestic workers
coded.vl: Fees capped
coded.n: Service fees capped.

coded.vl: Mandatory, with content specific to domestic work
coded.n: Mandatory orientation.

coded.vl: Compulsory and covering domestic workers
coded.n: Overseas Employment Support Fund.

coded.vl: Attachés in some destinations, few or no shelters
coded.n: Labor attachés in some destinations.

coded.fn: Domestic workers at home protected by labor law
coded.vl: Covered by statute
coded.n: Labor Code chapter on domestic workers.

coded.vl: One
coded.n: Saudi Arabia agreement on domestic workers (2014).
